scope: Source discovery and public metadata, without new trait values, K values, family effects, source overlap outcomes or phylogenetic signal.

discovery_only_targets.name: seed_width
discovery_only_targets.semantics: linear dimension of seed, exclude seed coat/fruit width substitutions

discovery_only_targets.name: leaf_area
discovery_only_targets.semantics: projected single leaf area, lamina only. Compound leaf vs leaflet ambiguity requires AusTraits APD/source row-level audit; TRY generic 1,3110,3113,3114 are NOT automatically interchangeable.

discovery_only_targets.name: seed_dry_mass
discovery_only_targets.semantics: single dry seed mass, exclude dispersal unit/fruit mass or 1000 seed mass without certified conversion

discovery_only_targets.name: leaf_width
discovery_only_targets.semantics: max lamina width, exclude petiole and leaflet-only without recorded taxonomy

discovery_only_targets.name: petiole_length
discovery_only_targets.semantics: petiole length, do not merge rachis or compound leaf stem length without source-level mapping

sources.name: TRY Plant Trait Database version 7
sources.notes: The summary is a database-wide count, not a qualified count per trait/family. TRY includes secondary/collective datasets; new release does not imply independent primary measurements.

sources.name: MorFunSeed Cerrado and Atlantic Forest
sources.notes: 131 total species is fewer than the strict 10 families times 20 unique species per trait = 200 necessary count, so this source alone cannot qualify on the original protocol; it could still support complementary trait-specific checks.

sources.name: Western Ghats woody leaf traits 2025
sources.notes: 93 total species cannot meet >=200 distinct species for any one qualifying trait under frozen >=10 families x 20 species condition. Leaf area was measured on leaf blades without petioles.

prohibited_changes: No K/result-based source selection or reweighting
Do not reopen completed BIEN 201-system rho analysis
Do not reinterpret a derivative compilation as independent without primary DOI/measurement audit
Do not relax 10-family x20-species gates after finding small datasets
